scope: XiaoYu one-click QQ transport lifecycle; no QQ credential ownership

native_authorities.overlay_role: detect configured local napcat_forward endpoint, start existing NapCat Desktop only when needed, surface bounded login-required notice

live_evidence.current_qq_login_state: expired; NapCat native SetQuickLogin returned login session expired / re-login required

behavior: Act only when qq_connection_mode=napcat_forward and the OneBot URL is loopback.
Do nothing when configured endpoint is already reachable.
Do not duplicate an existing NapCatQQ-Desktop process.
Start installed NapCatQQ-Desktop.exe when local OneBot is configured but the external runtime is absent.
Wait at most 15 seconds after a fresh NapCat launch before declaring OneBot unready.
Show an 8-second login-required notice when OneBot remains unavailable; -SuppressNapCatNotice disables the notice for tests/automation.
Never call QQLogin/PasswordLogin or QQLogin/SetQuickLogin from the overlay.

blocker.detail: The saved QQ quick-login session in NapCat is expired. A one-time login in NapCatQQ Desktop is required before OneBot port 3001 can become ready.
